personal.about: Third-year Software Development student at the University of Applied Sciences Utrecht. I build things end to end — a published npm package for animated ASCII backgrounds, a Rust CLI and REST API for controlling earbuds on Linux, and client work for a restaurant group. Comfortable across TypeScript, Java and Rust, and happiest with a problem that needs taking apart. Eight years in hospitality alongside it taught me to work under pressure and communicate with people who do not share my vocabulary.

experience.description: Table service in a restaurant, building on eight years of hospitality experience.
Improving AI models through data annotation, transcription correction, and quality-focused training tasks. Completed work on Project Aether; currently between project assignments.
Worked in a fine-dining restaurant, handling mostly bar service and some table service.
Worked in a ski-resort. Long hours, but gained a lot of experience and knowledge.
Provided table service in a restaurant and improved my customer service and teamwork skills.

education.description: Specializing in software development, with courses and projects in both front-end and back-end technologies (JavaScript, Java, HTML, etc.).

projects.name: F.L.O.W.
